writeLease.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=false; sort_keys=true; separators=(',',':'); SHA-256

forbiddenWrites: live runtime, Task Scheduler, network, external model or public state

observedRed.actual: exit 0 with no CLI output because module exposes functions only and has no module entrypoint
observedRed.expected: nonzero typed NEWS_GRASP_ENTRY fault after durable initial WAL; subsequent normal invocation resumes and emits one JSON result line

cliContract.mapping: call existing dispatch with raw_argv exactly ['dispatch','--schedule-id',scheduleId,'--intent',intent], Path runtime/manifest, parsed datetime, parsed writer mapping and optional boundary_hook
cliContract.success: write exactly one compact UTF-8 JSON object line to stdout and return 0; no stderr
cliContract.failure: write exactly one stable typed NEWS_GRASP_ENTRY_* reason line to stderr, no traceback/path/secret/value echo, return nonzero
cliContract.fault: when flag is present, boundary_hook raises only at after_initial_wal_fsync with typed reason NEWS_GRASP_ENTRY_FAULT_AFTER_INITIAL_WAL; initial WAL remains durable and no later parse/SQLite action occurs
cliContract.manifest: corrupt/missing manifest preserves existing CleanroomEntryError.reason NEWS_GRASP_ENTRY_MANIFEST_INVALID and is distinguishable from fault injection
cliContract.input: reject invalid command shape, path, writer JSON, datetime or unknown option before calling dispatch using a stable NEWS_GRASP_ENTRY_ARGS_INVALID or existing typed reason

humanImpact.CREATE_NO_WINDOW: caller-owned; module launches no subprocess or UI

security: stdlib only; no shell, eval, dynamic import, environment trust or command string
read only the explicitly supplied writer and manifest paths; controller remains authority for manifest semantics
never include raw argv, writer contents, paths or exception text in stderr
do not catch KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit as application failures

verification.s6: $env:NEWS_GRASP_HIGH_COST_BINDING_PATH=[Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables('%USERPROFILE%\bin\news-grasp-high-cost-binding-v1.json'); py -3.12 -m pytest --noconftest -q tests/test_news_grasp_cleanroom_s6_release.py; if oracle correction commit is not yet present, run the exact L6 helper/node and report remaining oracle dependencies without editing them
verification.diff: git diff --check and exact one owned path only

implementationRules: extend the current thin wrapper; do not duplicate Controller reconciliation logic
keep imports side-effect free; main runs only under module execution
test-specific case names and weakening existing function API are forbidden

commitPolicy.allowedOnlyAfter: compile, Ruff, S1 and strongest available S6 CLI evidence
commitPolicy.message: feat: add S6 dispatch CLI boundary

causalRetry: one implementation attempt and one causally distinct correction only; do not change tests
delivery: file hash/bytes, exact commands/counts, commit and clean status
stopPolicy: return to Sol; no other production, test, live or global mutation
